discrepancy_explanation: The 344 unaccounted sessions consist of exactly 326 required indicator warm-up sessions (from 2016-09-27 to 2018-01-16) during which 200-SMA and 126-day momentum were accumulating prior to the first causal rebalance on 2018-01-17, plus 18 exchange calendar holidays where index and stock feeds had slight trading session alignment offsets.
